instruction: Merge the visible layers, clipping the result to the image rather than expanding it.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc', format: 'sexpr', key: 'layer-merge-type', default: 'expand-as-necessary' } ] }); return data[0]; }
